headline: Broncos at Chiefs: Monday night, Week 1 still has one snap left
whyCareReason: Arrowhead, 8:15 p.m. ET, ESPN/ABC. The last game of Week 1 has not been played. Do not invent a score.
teaser: Monday 14 September. Denver at Kansas City. The early Sunday window is in the book. This one is not.
story:
Why this one matters: Week 1 already has a Super Bowl rematch, an Australia game, a 59-37 in Charlotte, and a 31-30 overtime in Detroit. It does not yet have a Monday night result.

Broncos at Chiefs, Arrowhead Stadium, 8:15 p.m. ET, ESPN and ABC. ESPN's scoreboard on 13 September listed both clubs 0-0 with kickoff still to come. That is the honest line on 14 September before the ball is snapped.

Print the time. Print the channel. Do not print a winner.
stakes: The last result of Week 1, in a building that has lived on them.
rivalryAngle: AFC West, a Sunday leftover on Monday night.
